channel.title: Left Voice – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Left Voice – Bias and Credibility (leftvoice.org)

item.title: Victories for Revolutionary Socialists in France Show the Power of Running Openly Anti-Capitalist Campaigns - Left Voice
item.description: Running on an uncompromisingly anti-capitalist platform, socialists with Révolution Permanente in France won 12,000 votes nationally and brought two members to city council in Saint-Denis. Their achievements hold lessons for socialists everywhere.

item.title: Build a Mass International Movement Against the Imperialist War in Iran! For the Defeat of the United States and Israel! - Left Voice
item.description: The imperialist offensive by the United States and Israel against Iran and its allies has extended across the Middle East without a clear way out. Working-class and young people must unite to build an international mass movement against imperialist war, building on the anti-imperialist struggle against the genocide in Palestine and the fight against the Trump’s reactionary policies.

item.title: In Jersey City, DSA is Fighting for Hospitals as a Public Good - Left Voice
item.description: Members of the Democratic Socialists of America were recently arrested for protesting the closure of a hospital in Jersey City. One of these DSA organizers, Isaac Jimenez, spoke with Left Voice about how private, for-profit healthcare and gentrification is harming the city’s access to quality health services.

item.title: Solidarity with the NYU Contract Faculty Strike - Left Voice
item.description: Full time, non-tenure-track professors at New York University went on strike this week for their first contract.

item.title: The Movement to Abolish ICE Must Fight for Full Rights for All Immigrants - Left Voice
item.description: Trump's war on immigrants is the most visible expression of a system that has long treated millions as a permanent underclass of the country they have built. Now the movement against his attacks has to go on the offensive, which means putting the fight for full rights for all immigrants at the center of the struggle.

item.title: Biggest No Kings Demonstration Ever Brings Millions to the Streets - Left Voice
item.description: From the unprovoked war on Iran to the war on immigrants at home, Trump’s policies are driving millions of people into the streets across the world.

item.title: Die Linke Leadership Is Attempting to Silence Pro-Palestinian Voices - Left Voice
item.description: Adoption of a motion critical of Zionism at a regional conference of Die Linke has sparked a major scandal in Germany. As intelligence agencies threaten to launch an investigation, the party leadership has condemned the motion, revealing Die Linke's internal tensions.

item.title: Right-Wing Governments in Latin America Face Short Honeymoons - Left Voice
item.description: Explosive student demonstrations are challenging the policies of far-right president José Antonio Kast, just two weeks into his first term. Similar resistance across Latin America suggests the rapid rise of the Far Right in the region will not go unchecked by workers and students.

item.title: Prairieland Anti-ICE Protesters Face Decades in Prison - Left Voice
item.description: A protest against ICE in Alvarado, Texas left an officer injured. The prosecution labeled it an assault by an “Antifa terror cell.” Now protesters face decades in prison, and the U.S. Left faces a chilling precedent.

item.title: Israel Passes Law Imposing Death Penalty for Palestinians, Ramping Up Repression in the West Bank - Left Voice
item.description: The new legislation, which would impose the death penalty for Palestinians who fight occupation with lethal force, is part of a larger offensive to repress resistance in the West Bank.

item.title: With All Eyes on the Middle East, the Trump Administration Advances Its “Donroe Doctrine” in Latin America - Left Voice
item.description: Trump is aggressively fulfilling his promise to advance U.S. imperialism in Latin America, collaborating with the region’s far-right leaders. Class struggle, and mobilization across the Americas against U.S. imperialism, can beat back this advance.

item.title: No Kings NYC Showed a City Willing to Fight. Let's Mobilize That Energy for May Day - Left Voice
item.description: New York came out in force for the third "No Kings" day of action. Left Voice marched with the banners "Full Rights for Immigrants" and "Down with the Imperialist War in Iran."

item.title: Down with Political Blacklisting: Reinstate the CUNY Fired Fourth - Left Voice
item.description: Over the summer of 2025, four CUNY adjuncts were fired from Brooklyn College (CUNY) as a result of their activism for Palestine: a serious attack on the Palestine movement, academic freedom, and worker rights. But CUNY students and workers did not let the attacks stand.

item.title: Trump's National Address Can't Mask the Crisis Caused by His War in Iran - Left Voice
item.description: On Wednesday night, Donald Trump addressed the nation on the current state of the war against Iran. But his triumphalist and lie-filled speech fails to disguise the reality of the conflict which he has no way to resolve.

item.title: The Coalition Seeking to Contain Chaos in the Middle East - Left Voice
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Egypt, and Pakistan are trying to contain the U.S.-Israel war on Iran and prevent a regional collapse that threatens to engulf the entire region.
